div.l: Of court . ⁊and to ben estately of manere .
And to ben holden . digne of reuerence .
But for to speken . of hir conscience .
Sche was so charitable . ⁊and so pitous .
Sche wolde wepe . if sche sawe a mous .
Kaught in a trappe . if it were deed or bledde .
Of smale houndis had sche . that sche fedde .
With rosted flesch . or mylke or wastell breed .
But sore wepte sche . if eny of hem were deed .
Or if men smote hēm with a yerde smerte .
And all was conscience . ⁊and tendyrnes of herte .
Full semely her wympell . pynched was .
Her nose was streight . hir yen grey as glas .
Hir mouthe full small . ⁊and ther to softe ⁊and reed .
But sikerly . sche had a fayre forheed .
It was almost . a spanne brode I trowe .
For hardely . sche was not vndirgrowe .
Full fetis was hir cloke . as I was war .
Of smale corall . a boute hir arme sche bar .
A peyre of bedis . gauded all wiþ grene .
And ther on henge . a broche of gold full schene .
On whiche . ther was first . wretyn a crowned A .
And after . Amor Vincit Omnia .
A nother Nonne . with hir had sche
That was hir Chapeleyn . ⁊and prestis thre .
A Monk ther was . a faire for the maystrie .
An out Rider . that loued venerie .
A manly man . to ben an abbot able .
Full many a deynte hors . had he in stable .
And whan he rode men myght his brydell here .
Clynkyng in a whistelyng wynde . as clere .
And eke as lowde . as doth the chapell belle .
Ther as this lorde . was keper of the celle .
The rewle of seynt Maure . or of seynt beneit .
By cause that it was olde . ⁊and somdell streit .
This ilke monke . leet olde thyngis pace .
And heeld after . the newe worlde the space .
He yaf nought of the text . a pulled hen .
That seyeth . that hunters be nought holy men .
Ne that a monke . whan he is recheles .
Is likned till a fische . that is waterles .
This is to seie . a monk . out of his cloistre .
But thilke text . heeld he nought worth an oistre .
And I seide . his opynyon was right good .
What schulde he studye . or make hym self wood .
Vp on a book . in cloistre all weie to poure .
Or swynke with hondis . or laboure .
